name: Task (go-task)
description: Installs Task (https://taskfile.dev), the Taskfile task runner, as a sha256-verified release binary at /usr/local/bin/task with bash/zsh completions.

installTaskfile.description: Also install this Feature's Taskfile into /usr/local/share/go-task/includes.d so its tasks appear under the <id>: namespace of a root Taskfile that includes /usr/local/share/go-task/features.yml (see the go-task Feature).

taskAliases.description: Opt in to team task aliases: install the task-aliases generator and a sha256-verified yq (one more download), and include the generated aliases in the features include (flattened). A team file (teamAliasesFile) maps short names to existing tasks; `task go-task:aliases` regenerates the wrappers, each alias shows in `task --list`. See the Feature's notes.

teamAliasesFile.description: Path of the team aliases file, relative to the folder of the root Taskfile (or absolute). Absent file means no aliases. Only read when taskAliases is true.

version.description: Task release to install (e.g. '3.54.0', with or without a leading 'v'), or 'latest'.

yqVersion.description: yq release the aliases generator uses (e.g. '4.54.1', with or without a leading 'v'), or 'latest' (resolves to the newest release at build time). Only installed when taskAliases is true.
